app.name: Gekko2 SPEED BETA12.28 ALPHA CORE
app.long_description: Grouped persistent settings, physical CLUT views, two-circuit GS scanout, native PS2 card and standard FAT/MCSERV, precise IPU CPU FIFO retries. Chain residency, extended PSM conversion and GX risk remain independent and factory OFF; apply at Cold Boot. Bring your own legal BIOS/disc. No confirmed new Wii gameplay, FPS or BIOS tile fix. Existing MemoryCard1.ps2 is optional; never implicitly created or formatted.
